items.prompt: Why can a correctly framed response after a send still fail to prove a durable accepted trade?
items.modelAnswer: Framing only separates bytes. Need authenticated peer/session, schema/units/identity checks, application request/acknowledgement meaning, duplicate/replay policy, commit/durability evidence and reconciliation. TCP send counts and connection closure do not supply these guarantees.

criteria.text: Separates byte framing from application meaning.
Does not claim transport progress proves durable acceptance.
